name: project_path_doctor
purpose: Windows PATH auditor that reports dead entries, duplicates and shadowed executables, resolving machine and user PATH in true composition order.
notes: First Rust project on this machine, chosen as a workflow shakedown. Deliberately read-only in slice 1: it reports, it never writes PATH. Born from real PATH shadowing hit during machine provisioning on 2026-09-15. Slice 1 progress: registry reading and PATH composition done (winreg, chosen over the windows crate so the unsafe stays in the dependency); executable enumeration, shadow detection and output formatting still to come.
